title: Gene Circuits
description: Wire genes so each controls the next and you have a switch, a clock, a memory: life made to compute. Unlocks the Gene Circuit Loom and the Living Catalyst.

puzzle.goal: A gene is repressed by r units of repressor, with half-repression at K and steepness n. Write its output Y, falling as K^n over K^n plus r^n.
puzzle.name: Hill repression
puzzle.form: K ^ n / ( K ^ n + r ^ n )
puzzle.expr: K ^ n / ( K ^ n + r ^ n )
puzzle.ask: Find Y for K = @{K}, n = @{n} and r = @{r}.
puzzle.method: The mirror of the binding curve: output high when the repressor is low, and steep enough (n > 1) to latch.
